Class PythonAnnotationTypes

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.util.PythonAnnotationTypes
@Internal public final class PythonAnnotationTypes extends Object
Answers, for a Java type seen by the Python processor, whether it is an annotation type and whether that annotation may be placed on other annotation types.

The Python processor and transformer used to answer these questions themselves by poking javax.lang.model elements through interop with string comparisons. Both now call this class.

Since:
5.2.0

    • targetsAnnotationType

      public static boolean targetsAnnotationType(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement)
      Whether the annotation type may be applied to annotation types, which is how a decorator generated for it learns that it may be applied to Python-defined annotations. Java permits an annotation type without @Target (such as jakarta.inject.Singleton) on every declaration but type parameters, annotation types included; only an explicit @Target that leaves out ANNOTATION_TYPE excludes it.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The element
      Returns:
      Whether the annotation may target annotation types

    • retentionPolicy

      public static RetentionPolicy retentionPolicy(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement)
      The retention of the annotation type. Java keeps an annotation without @Retention in the class file only (RetentionPolicy.CLASS), so that is the answer when the element declares none.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The annotation element
      Returns:
      The retention policy

    • targetsDeclaration

      public static boolean targetsDeclaration(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement, ElementType declaration)
      Whether the annotation type may be placed on a declaration of the given kind. An annotation without @Target may be placed on every declaration; an explicit @Target has to name the declaration kind itself. ElementType.TYPE_USE is deliberately not treated as permitting a declaration: a type-use annotation belongs to the type, not the member.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The annotation element
      declaration - The declaration kind (ElementType.TYPE, ElementType.FIELD, ElementType.METHOD, ...)
      Returns:
      Whether the annotation may be placed on such a declaration

    • nestedTypes

      public static List<PythonAnnotationTypes.NestedType> nestedTypes(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement, Function<String, @Nullable Object> lookup)
      The types nested in an annotation, in one answer: the declared nested types first, then the nested types returned by the annotation's members, each once. The transformer used to walk the members from Python, several host calls per member; the lookup callback resolves a nested type by its binary or source name.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The annotation element
      lookup - Resolves a class element by name, or null
      Returns:
      The nested types
